reference: Dolostone, Knox Dolomite, Warren County core (Commons title)

description.lithology: The core is dominated by a light- to medium-grey, fine- to medium-grained carbonate / marble-like rock with a mottled / faintly banded fabric. Upper three tray rows are light grey with darker grey mottling and subtle laminations / streaky fabric; the fourth and fifth tray rows show a distinct colour change to a darker grey to grey-black, finer-grained, laminated to weakly foliated rock with a more massive to banded appearance. Grain size appears fine to medium, texture is massive to faintly laminated / banded with local irregular mottling. The overall fabric is weakly layered / streaky, more pronounced in the darker lower portion.
description.alteration: none visible; the rock surfaces appear fresh to slightly weathered with no obvious chloritic, sericitic, silicified, potassic, carbonate or oxidised alteration discernible at photo resolution.
description.mineralization: none visible; no clearly identifiable sulfide or ore minerals such as pyrite, chalcopyrite, pyrrhotite, sphalerite or galena can be confidently recognised in the image. A single dark circular spot is present on the fourth row core piece but its nature cannot be confirmed at this resolution.

anomalies.explanation: A distinct lithology colour / fabric contact is visible between the light-grey upper rows and the darker grey to grey-black lower rows, with the change occurring around the fourth tray row from the top.
Core is broken into multiple pieces with several gaps / missing intervals, e.g., top row right end and fourth row left end, and a small labelled core piece is present in the top row.
